prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, sunlit anime-style beach scene featuring two cheerful young women sitting side by side under the shade of palm trees. Both have large, expressive eyes and warm smiles, exuding a sense of friendship and summer joy. The girl on the left has short, wavy pink hair and wears a light pink t-shirt with the word "SUN" printed on it, paired with matching pink shorts. She holds a delicate white and pink flower in one hand and has a pair of sunglasses perched atop her head. The girl on the right has long, straight red hair and wears a deeper pink t-shirt adorned with a stylized sun graphic, along with matching shorts. A cute, cartoonish bee with big eyes and tiny wings sits playfully on her head, adding a whimsical touch. Both girls have sunglasses resting on their heads, and their skin glows softly in the bright, natural light. The background features a clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, turquoise ocean waves, and distant palm trees, evoking a tropical paradise. The color palette is dominated by warm pinks, sunny yellows, and cool blues, with crisp, clean linework and a soft, inviting atmosphere. The composition is intimate and friendly, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the two characters while gently blurring the idyllic beach setting behind them. The overall style is polished, colorful, and reminiscent of high-quality anime illustrations, capturing a carefree summer moment.
